passives.name: PeronaEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
When a $OnePieceCategory unit attacks an enemy within this unit's range:
- Enemies hit are inflicted with $Gloom for {1}s
- $Gloom: Enemies afflicted are immobilized for {2}s and cannot inflict $StatusEffects on units for the effect's duration

On attack against enemies afflicted with $Gloom, inflict $Possession
- $Possession: Upon death, revive as friendly summon for {3}% of this unit's damage

(Summon Cap: {4})
